decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 11.2	The application for the demolition of the existing bathroom and garden room and the erection of a single storey rear extension and provision of new double doors from the rear of the existing first floor, as shown on drawing number 3529/2a received 6 September 2005, is recommended for approval as the proposed development would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of existing rear bathroom and garden room and erection of single storey rear/side extension incorporating roof lights and insertion of double doors at first floor to house
